# BizQuest Business-for-Sale Listing & Financials Extractor

BizQuest lists businesses, franchises and commercial real estate for sale across the US. This actor pulls listing cards from any BizQuest search URL or filter combination, and can optionally enrich each one with its full detail page — description, financials, broker contact and photos.

## What this actor does

- Fetches listings from any BizQuest search URL you provide, or builds one from a keyword and/or US state filter
- Paginates automatically through search results up to `maxItems`
- Optionally fetches each listing's own detail page for full description, financial breakdown, broker contact and photos
- Returns a dedicated error record (with the failed URL and reason) when a page can't be fetched or parsed, instead of silently skipping it
- Empty fields are omitted from records

## Output per listing

- `url` — canonical listing detail URL
- `listingId` — BizQuest listing ID, e.g. `BW2398228`
- `title` — listing title
- `priceLabel`, `askingPrice` — asking price as shown on the page, and parsed to a number in USD when it's a real figure (omitted for "Undisclosed")
- `cashFlowLabel`, `cashFlow` — cash flow/EBITDA as shown, and parsed to USD when available
- `location`, `city`, `state` — listing location
- `shortDescription` — short teaser text from the listing card
- `thumbnail` — primary listing image
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

### Additional fields when `fetchDetails` is enabled

- `description` — full listing description
- `reasonForSelling`, `trainingOffered`, `support` — seller-provided notes, when published
- `grossRevenue`, `ebitda`, `inventoryValue`, `ffeValue`, `realEstateValue`, `monthlyRent` — financial figures in USD, when disclosed
- `yearEstablished`, `employees`, `sellerFinancing`, `buildingSqft`, `lotSize`, `franchiseBrand` — business details, when disclosed
- `brokerName`, `brokerCompany`, `brokerPhone` — broker contact info, only when publicly shown on the page
- `photos` — list of listing image URLs
- `listingType` — `business` or `franchise`

### Error records

If a URL fails to fetch or parse, the run emits `{inputUrl, error, scrapedAt}` for that URL instead of skipping it silently.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `startUrls` | array | – | BizQuest search or listing URLs; paste any filtered search URL from BizQuest.com. When left empty (and no `keyword`/`location` given), the run falls back to the main browse-all listing page |
| `keyword` | string | – | Keyword filter, used to build a search URL when no matching `startUrls` filter is supplied |
| `location` | string | – | US state, full name or 2-letter abbreviation |
| `fetchDetails` | boolean | `false` | Fetch each listing's detail page for description, financials, broker info and photos |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Maximum listings to return (1–10,000) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | residential | Apify proxy configuration; a residential proxy materially improves success on detail-page fetches |

### Example: browse by state

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://www.bizquest.com/businesses-for-sale-in-california-ca/"],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: keyword and location filter with detail enrichment

```json
{
  "startUrls": [],
  "keyword": "pizza",
  "location": "FL",
  "fetchDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: a single listing with full detail

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://www.bizquest.com/business-for-sale/thriving-turnkey-daycare-center/BW2417284/"],
  "fetchDetails": true
}
```

## Use cases

- **Acquisition sourcing** — build a pipeline of businesses for sale that match your target price and location
- **Market sizing** — count how many businesses in a given industry or state are currently listed
- **Broker and franchise research** — survey which brokers or franchise brands are actively listing
- **Financial screening** — filter opportunities by asking price, cash flow or revenue once fetched
- **Monitoring** — re-run on a schedule and compare `listingId` sets to spot new or removed listings

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with BizQuest?** No. This is an independent listing extraction tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by BizQuest.

**Do I need an account?** No. Only publicly visible listing data is extracted.

**What's the difference between using `startUrls` and using `keyword`/`location`?** `startUrls` accepts any BizQuest search or listing URL, including filters set up on BizQuest.com itself (city, industry, price range, etc.). `keyword` and `location` are a convenience shortcut that builds a basic search URL for you; combine both approaches in one run if needed.

**Can I filter by city, industry or price range?** Yes, by applying those filters on BizQuest.com's own search page and pasting the resulting URL into `startUrls`.

**Why are some prices shown as "Undisclosed" with no numeric value?** Many sellers choose not to publish an exact asking price or cash flow. The original label is kept in `priceLabel`/`cashFlowLabel`, while the numeric `askingPrice`/`cashFlow` field is omitted when there's no real figure to parse.

**Why does `fetchDetails` sometimes return fewer extra fields than expected?** Detail pages are harder to fetch reliably than listing cards, especially from non-residential network paths; when a detail fetch doesn't succeed, the record falls back to the listing-card data it already has.

**Why is `brokerPhone` often missing?** Many brokers hide their phone number behind a "Contact Broker" form rather than publishing it directly on the page; only publicly visible numbers are extracted.

**How many listings are typically available per search?** It varies by filter; broad state-level searches commonly return hundreds to low thousands of listings, paginated automatically up to `maxItems`.

**Can I run this on a schedule to track new listings?** Yes — re-run periodically and compare the `listingId` values between runs to detect new or removed listings.
